releaseNotes.headline: Claude reset times without another sign-in

highlights.detail: Recent cached Claude responses supply exact reset timestamps and limits scoped to a model or surface.
highlights.title: Reported reset times

highlights.detail: Reading Claude's desktop usage cache makes no network request and needs no extra login, cookies, or Keychain permission.
highlights.title: Silent local reads

highlights.detail: Only recent, validated cache data supplies resets. Other usage sources remain available, and missing reset times stay — instead of being estimated.
highlights.title: Fresh data only

releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.20 reads Claude's fresh local usage cache to show reported reset times, without an extra login or Keychain permission.
